$schema: Coverage map of the dogfood sessions: what was run, how, on which data, and what is still untested. Bugs live in GitHub issues (labels bug, P0-P3, confirmed), not here. Validate: node .agents/skills/wick-charts-dogfood/scripts/coverage.mjs check

sessions.approach: Full session. 1 data agent fetched 15 real datasets (pinned windows); 3 framework agents (React, Vue, Svelte) each built the same 26 scenarios in a fresh Vite app linked to the monorepo build, plus framework probes (StrictMode, SSR import, reactive proxies, in-place mutation, packaging, strict type-check). Tech lead re-checked P0/P1 claims, ran pixel compares in the default and zoom states, filed issues.
notes: Per-team data adapters caused most default-render pixel diffs; next full session starts with shared adapters (test/dogfood/shared/scenarios/<id>.ts).
The default-render compare is a contract check; the zoom state caught the wrapper bug (a 0.32% diff in axis labels).
Two teams found the same core bug independently: overlap across frameworks is cheap verification.
Teams graded the same bug differently (OK vs BUG); the brief now says any attached finding means BUG.
Svelte 5 blocked the runes probes; they stay unrun until it works.

sessions.approach: Focused session, tech lead alone, new angle: the shadcn/ui registry (registry/shadcn). A fresh `shadcn init -t vite -p nova` app (test/dogfood/shadcn, port 5184) installed all six blocks with `npx shadcn add` from a local registry build; @wick-charts/react 0.8.3 from npm. Captured every block idle + hover in light and dark, a runtime `.dark` toggle, colored --chart-N tokens set on <html> at runtime, the full page at 375 px. Compared the crosshair pill with the docs line page.
notes: The Nova preset ships grayscale --chart-1..5 (chart-1 is oklch(0.87 0 0)): anything colored by series color goes near-invisible on a light card. Test light themes with the default palette, not only ?tokens=color.
Tailwind preflight sets a unitless line-height that DOM overlays inherit; compare overlay geometry against the docs page before calling a misalignment Tailwind-only.
No agents needed: six registry blocks fit one tech-lead pass (about 25 captures).

sessions.approach: Full session after 62 commits. Tech lead fetched one new dataset (orderbook-snapshots) with a fetcher, wrote shared adapters for 4 new scenarios (depth-btc, depth-pepe, category-mix, pepe-volume), built once. Three framework agents (React, Vue, Svelte 5 runes) re-shot the 26 old scenarios, built the 4 new ones and re-checked 32 closed issues on the same data; a fourth agent installed the shadcn registry from the live URL into a Next.js App Router app (@wick-charts/react 0.8.4 from npm): build, SSR/hydration, theme, 375 px, client navigation, Server Component children. Tech lead: Vite shadcn app sweep vs the 2026-10-21 shots, default / zoom / hover compares, verified both P1s.
notes: The fix re-check table (issue | scenario | fixed / NOT fixed) made re-checks cheap: 84 of 85 framework rows came back fixed; keep it in every session after a fix wave.

Most default-render diffs were contract drift again: React and Svelte pass an explicit fullRange(), Vue the default viewport. Next session the shared scenario files must own the viewport, not only the data.
The plan wrongly said "mount before data, as React does": the React app mounts after data. Check the reference app before writing a contract line about it.
The hover compare caught a wrapper split (React tooltip fixed at 160 px, Vue/Svelte content-sized) that every team had filed as core or not at all.
Shared adapters with .ts import extensions need allowImportingTsExtensions in each app, and must pass noUncheckedIndexedAccess (the Vue app uses it).
A Next.js team needs experimental.reactDebugChannel: false and short dev runs: the sandbox blocks the dev WebSocket.
The Server Component children probe found the only P1 in the wrapper layer: test composition from a server page, not only "use client" blocks.

sessions.approach: Focused session, tech lead alone, new angle: the shadcn-vue registry (registry/shadcn-vue) before its first release. Two fresh `shadcn-vue init` apps (reka-nova style): Vite (test/dogfood/shadcn-vue, port 5186) installed all eleven blocks by URL, Nuxt 4 (test/dogfood/shadcn-nuxt, port 5187) by name through a components.json registries entry, both from a local registry build with localhost URLs; @wick-charts/vue 0.8.5 from npm. Checked the installed files against the sources, vue-tsc with strict + noUnusedLocals, vite build, every block in light and dark, a runtime `.dark` toggle, and the Nuxt dev console for SSR and hydration warnings.
notes: shadcn-vue places files by their registry path: keep the sources under components/, components/ui/<name>/ and composables/ so blocks land in @/components, not in @/components/blocks.
The installed shadcn-vue card imports `cn` from the `cn` npm package, while init still writes @/lib/utils; registry files that import @/lib/utils keep working.
pnpm 12 stops `shadcn-vue init` on ignored esbuild build scripts; npm in the app folder avoids it.

sessions.approach: Focused session on the new integrations, installed from the public docs and the live registry. A Nuxt agent followed only /integrations/nuxt/ and the README in fresh Nuxt 4 apps (npm, strict pnpm, Vuetify, color-mode, prefix options): SSR, generate, nuxi typecheck, Lazy*, keepalive navigation, streaming, every registered component. A shadcn-vue agent installed all 11 Vue blocks from https://wick-charts.eeff.io/r/vue/ into a fresh Vite app, the existing shadcn-nuxt app and a new shadcn-nuxt app with @wick-charts/nuxt, then swapped two blocks to real data (pepe-1h, orderbook-snapshots). Tech lead: React blocks re-added from the live URL into the Vite and Next.js shadcn apps, all-blocks diff vs 2026-10-21-full, hover light/dark, 320/375 px, Next.js production build, live docs pages at 1280/375; verified every P1 and most P2 claims, plus a Svelte static-tooltip control.
notes: Check npm for the "unpublished" package at the start: @wick-charts/nuxt went public mid-session and the teams switched to it.
A <Title> in a scenario fires overlayChange and hid the Vue static-tooltip P1 for a whole session: keep a title-less, static-data variant of every overlay tooltip.
headless Chrome inherits the OS dark mode: a "system" theme app renders dark, which exposed the SSR theme mismatch. Force the scheme per capture (localStorage, param, or emulateMediaFeatures).
The docs demo frame at 375 px is narrower than an app at 375 px; capture registry blocks at 320 px too.
Two agents (~0.64M tokens, ~40 min) plus the tech lead covered three integration tracks; the React registry sweep needed no agent because the installed files had not changed.
zsh: a loop variable named `path` overwrites PATH.

ideas.idea: Log Y scale on real data: the 235x wiki spike, PEPE from listing, a series that touches 0
ideas.why: Feature 995d9e5 shipped without dogfooding; log of 0 / negatives is the classic trap

ideas.idea: Left-side Y axis (68cfb25) with a secondary right scale and long tick labels
ideas.why: Shipped, never dogfooded

ideas.idea: Sunspots (SILSO, monthly since 1749) or Central England Temperature (since 1659)
ideas.why: Negative epoch ms and year < 1900 break naive date formatting and interval detection

ideas.idea: Daily candles aligned to local midnight in Asia/Kolkata (+5:30) and Asia/Kathmandu (+5:45); time format timeZone option
ideas.why: Tick snapping usually assumes whole-hour offsets

ideas.idea: Chart mounted inside a display:none tab, then shown
ideas.why: Zero-size init is the most common dashboard bug

ideas.idea: Stream for 5 min in a background tab (rAF paused), then return
ideas.why: Queued updates may burst, animate from stale state, or leak

ideas.idea: Pinch-zoom / pan / tooltip with touch emulation at 375 px
ideas.why: Mobile users; no current coverage

ideas.idea: SvelteKit (SSR + hydrate), Astro islands — Next.js App Router done in 2026-10-21-full, Nuxt 4 in 2026-10-22-integrations
ideas.why: Where real users install it; SSR import safety beyond a bare renderToString

ideas.idea: Pass CSV-parsed numeric strings ("1.23") without Number()
ideas.why: The most common user mistake; must fail loudly or coerce (DepthSeries with raw string tuples draws a blank chart: 2026-10-21-full)

ideas.idea: 1-hour stream: heap growth, DOM nodes, listeners
ideas.why: Leaks show only over time

ideas.idea: 20 synced charts on one page: FPS and crosshair sync
ideas.why: Dashboards

ideas.idea: devicePixelRatio change at runtime (window moved between monitors)
ideas.why: Blurry canvas until reload

ideas.idea: prefers-reduced-motion: do intros and streaming animations respect it?
ideas.why: Accessibility

ideas.idea: de-DE decimal comma, dir=rtl page
ideas.why: Formatting and layout assumptions

ideas.idea: webpack 5, TS moduleResolution node16/nodenext, exactOptionalPropertyTypes, CJS require in Node
ideas.why: Install friction outside Vite

ideas.idea: README UMD <script> snippet on a plain HTML page
ideas.why: Documented entry point, never exercised

ideas.idea: React EdgeLoader against the real paginated Binance klines API
ideas.why: Only mocked so far

ideas.idea: OWID COVID cases: negative corrections, weekly reporting artifacts
ideas.why: Real negative "counts"

ideas.idea: 500 categories on a category X axis
ideas.why: Label thinning at scale

ideas.idea: 365 x 24 hourly heatmap for a full year incl. both DST days
ideas.why: Heatmap at size

ideas.idea: Strict CSP (no unsafe-inline styles)
ideas.why: Enterprise installs

ideas.idea: Keyboard navigation and screen-reader text
ideas.why: Accessibility audit

ideas.idea: Same data, two mounts: series created with data vs created empty and fed after mount. Compare the initial Y range and visible window (engine-only probe + all three wrappers)
ideas.why: Open question O-1 from 2026-10-17: Svelte (mounts with data) shows a slightly lower Y range in band-weather and percent-npm

ideas.idea: Take an app written against an old release (test/react uses 0.3.4 from npm), upgrade to the current version following MIGRATION.md only
ideas.why: Existing users meet the library through upgrades, not fresh installs

ideas.idea: One agent per framework gets only the public llms.txt / llms-full.txt URL and a product task ("a crypto dashboard"), no repo access
ideas.why: Measures what an outside user or their AI assistant can build from the published docs alone

ideas.idea: Embed charts into an existing open-source dashboard (forms, routing, state manager, CSS framework) instead of a blank Vite app
ideas.why: Blank apps hide CSS conflicts, layout containers and state-library integration problems

ideas.idea: line-fred-mixed with the daily series first, then the monthly one; then three frequencies (DGS10 daily, UNRATE monthly, GDPC1 quarterly)
ideas.why: The zoom floor follows the first series (2026-10-21-full P1): check the other order and a third step

ideas.idea: Mount empty, first message brings 1 candle, then 1/s — plus viewport.initialRange: 60 on an empty start, in all three frameworks
ideas.why: The most common live case opens on a 200-bar window with the data squeezed right

ideas.idea: Record a Binance depthUpdate WebSocket stream (60 s, ~10 msg/s) with size-0 removals and string sizes; replay as updateData deltas
ideas.why: Only 20 full snapshots were tested; deltas, removals and high rates are the real order-book path

ideas.idea: Count fetches per user drag with a naive onEdgeReached handler in all three frameworks vs React EdgeLoader, paging over btc-1m-big
ideas.why: onEdgeReached fires several times per drag and only with one bar left

ideas.idea: React blocks on real data (chart-order-book on orderbook-snapshots, chart-candlestick on pepe-1h); a translucent bg-card/50 card; a Tailwind 3 HSL-token project; output: export. Vue blocks done in 2026-10-22-integrations
ideas.why: The blocks only ever ran on their own synthetic seeds

ideas.idea: Move the viewport (fullRange or default) into the shared scenario files and align all 26 old scenarios to them
ideas.why: Default-render diffs above 1% were all viewport drift between the apps in two sessions running

ideas.idea: The SSR theme-mismatch probe in Next.js, SvelteKit and plain Vue SSR, in both color schemes
ideas.why: React and Svelte also do not patch attribute mismatches after hydration; a light OS hides it

ideas.idea: Marker, TimeRegion and a vertical ReferenceLine with times left and right of the window, all frameworks
ideas.why: An off-screen Marker drew its label at the plot edge

ideas.idea: Type-check every registry item under the framework defaults: stock Nuxt 4 nuxi typecheck, Next.js, vue-tsc/tsc with noUncheckedIndexedAccess
ideas.why: Nuxt 4 enables noUncheckedIndexedAccess and the Vue blocks fail it with 28 errors

ideas.idea: Swap each registry block feed to a tiny-magnitude and a huge-magnitude dataset and diff labels against the library defaults
ideas.why: Block formatters are tuned to the demo prices and show 0 for pepe-1h

ideas.idea: Nuxt module prefix "" and short prefixes against Nuxt built-ins (Title, Link, Meta), shadcn-nuxt and Nuxt UI names
ideas.why: prefix "" silently lost Title and Tooltip

ideas.idea: useFetch with btc-1m-big (130k bars) in Nuxt SSR: payload size, TTFB, the NUXT_E8006 warning
ideas.why: 1500 candles already make 292 kB of a 294 kB page

ideas.idea: A check that no Vue component declares a prop named style, class or key
ideas.why: ReferenceLine `style` cannot take a static string in Vue

ideas.idea: A Svelte 5 runes app fills every overlay slot (Tooltip, InfoBar, Legend, YLabel, PieTooltip, PieLegend, SankeyTooltip) with `let:` and with a `{#snippet children(...)}`
ideas.why: The wick-charts skill tells runes users both forms work; a compile check passed, but no session or test renders them from a runes parent (TooltipSlotProbe compiles in legacy mode)
